join (SELECT eis_current.* FROM patient_identifier eis_current WHERE eis_current.voided=0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM patient_identifier eis_rank WHERE eis_rank.patient_id=eis_current.patient_id AND eis_rank.identifier_type=eis_current.identifier_type AND eis_rank.voided=0 AND ((COALESCE(eis_rank.preferred,0)=1 AND COALESCE(eis_current.preferred,0)=0) OR (COALESCE(eis_rank.preferred,0)=COALESCE(eis_current.preferred,0) AND eis_rank.patient_identifier_id BETWEEN 0 AND eis_current.patient_identifier_id AND eis_rank.patient_identifier_id!=eis_current.patient_identifier_id)))) pi on v.patient_id = pi.patient_id and pi.voided = 0

join (SELECT eis_current.* FROM person eis_current WHERE eis_current.voided=0) p on p.person_id = v.patient_id and p.voided = 0
join (select e1.*
from encounter e1
inner join (select visit_id, max(encounter_datetime) as max_date

where e1.voided = 0) en on en.visit_id = v.visit_id
join encounter_provider ep on ep.encounter_id = en.encounter_id and ep.voided = 0
